name: Vespid Dynamics Wasp Eye Tactical Monocle WE-3
product_name: Vespid Dynamics Wasp Eye Tactical Monocle WE-3
description: A multi-spectral optical device worn as a monocle or clip-on lens that overlays tactical information onto the wearer's visual field. The WE-3 combines visible light enhancement, thermal imaging, electromagnetic field visualization, and AR data overlays into a single eyepiece that can be switched between modes or display composite views. The device interfaces with neural implants for heads-up display integration and can share its feed with linked devices. Vespid designed it as a lightweight alternative to full tactical helmets for operators who need sensor capability without the bulk and visibility of military headgear.

specifications.info: thermal; EM field; AR overlay; composite

story_hooks: A WE-3 in EM visualization mode detected an unknown signal emanating from inside a person's skull — the signal was not from any known neural interface model and its purpose is unidentifiable.

Modified WE-3 units with facial recognition and criminal database access have become standard equipment for vigilante groups in Tier 2 — they are scanning every face they see and acting on the results.
related_entities: Vantablack Media Spectral Barrier Display System

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek monocle lens assembly with a minimalist frame that curves around the eye socket. The primary optic is a dark, slightly convex lens with subtle iridescent coating that hints at its multi-spectral capabilities. The frame is precision-engineered with minimal bulk—almost surgical in appearance—projecting an air of high-end tactical equipment rather than consumer tech.
physical_description.dimensions: Lens diameter: 32mm; frame depth: 18mm; total width: 48mm. Compact enough to sit naturally against the eye without protruding into peripheral vision.
physical_description.weight_description: 30 grams—featherweight, barely perceptible when worn. Designed to be forgotten after 30 seconds of use.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade polycarbonate frame with sapphire-coated optical glass lens. Interior components are titanium-aluminum alloy with carbon fiber reinforcement.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray frame with a faint non-reflective coating. The lens has a dark smoky tint with internal holographic micro-etching that creates subtle rainbow distortion at certain angles.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary, with accent lines in burnt orange (Vespid Dynamics signature). The lens itself appears deep charcoal with hints of cyan when powered and receiving signal.
physical_description.interface_elements: Micro-LED indicator strip (cyan-to-amber) along the frame's inner edge shows power and mode status. Ultra-thin touch-sensitive contact point on the temple arm for mode cycling (two-finger double-tap). Barely-visible neural port (gold-plated contact point) sits flush at the 6 o'clock position of the frame. Minimal physical buttons—all interaction is gesture or neural.
distinctive_features: Iridescent lens coating that shifts between dark purple and deep blue under different light angles
Near-invisible neural interface port with haptic feedback node
Micro-articulated frame hinge allowing 15-degree tilt adjustment for perfect eye alignment
Integrated heat-dispersal mesh visible as faint grid pattern around the lens perimeter
Subtle Vespid logo etched into the frame (stylized wasp silhouette) only visible up close
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS embossed on inner temple arm in 4pt serif font; WE-3 model designation stamped on the frame's rear curve; regulatory hologram (GLMZ safety cert) visible on the inside surface of the frame arm
physical_description.condition_typical: When powered on, a faint cyan glow emanates from the inner frame edges. In use, the lens surface occasionally shows subtle scan lines or thermal bloom effects if the wearer is cycling through modes. Well-maintained units retain their matte finish; heavy field use shows micro-scratches on the frame but the sapphire lens remains pristine.
